answer: Postal codes gate admission: the network mails a one-time code on a printed card to a physical street address, and each address may back only one identity per year. A farm needs a separate real mailbox per fake, so 50 heads mean 50 rented boxes, each costing money and leaving a paper trail. The code sits like a seed in a lotus pod, cracked open only by whoever holds the vault key of that address, a walnut shell no script can open remotely.
